name: Pacific Ocean
fact: The largest and deepest ocean, covering about a third of the Earth's surface.

name: Atlantic Ocean
fact: The second largest ocean, separating the Americas from Europe and Africa.

name: Indian Ocean
fact: The warmest ocean, bounded by Africa, Asia, Australia and the Southern Ocean.

name: Southern Ocean
fact: Encircles Antarctica and was formally recognised as a distinct ocean in 2000.

name: Arctic Ocean
fact: The smallest and shallowest ocean, largely covered by sea ice in winter.

name: Mediterranean Sea
fact: Almost entirely enclosed by land, connected to the Atlantic by the Strait of Gibraltar.

name: Caribbean Sea
fact: Bounded by Central America, South America and the islands of the West Indies.

name: South China Sea
fact: One of the busiest shipping routes in the world.

name: Bering Sea
fact: Separates Russia from Alaska, connected to the Arctic by the Bering Strait.

name: Red Sea
fact: Links to the Mediterranean through the Suez Canal and to the Indian Ocean at Bab-el-Mandeb.

name: Black Sea
fact: Connected to the Mediterranean only through the narrow Bosphorus strait.

name: Caspian Sea
fact: The largest inland body of water on Earth, with no outlet to the ocean.

name: North Sea
fact: Lies between Great Britain, Scandinavia and mainland Europe.

name: Baltic Sea
fact: One of the least salty seas in the world because of heavy river inflow.

name: Arabian Sea
fact: Part of the Indian Ocean between the Arabian Peninsula and India.

name: Bay of Bengal
fact: The largest bay in the world, bordered by India, Bangladesh and Myanmar.

name: Coral Sea
fact: Off the north-east coast of Australia, home to the Great Barrier Reef.

name: Tasman Sea
fact: Separates Australia from New Zealand, nicknamed 'the Ditch'.

name: Sea of Japan
fact: A marginal sea between the Japanese archipelago and the Asian mainland.

name: Yellow Sea
fact: Named for the golden silt carried into it by Chinese rivers.

name: Gulf of Mexico
fact: An ocean basin bordered by the United States, Mexico and Cuba.

name: Persian Gulf
fact: A shallow arm of the Indian Ocean between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula.

name: Adriatic Sea
fact: The arm of the Mediterranean between Italy and the Balkan Peninsula.

name: Aegean Sea
fact: Dotted with roughly 1,400 Greek and Turkish islands.

name: Norwegian Sea
fact: Unlike most Arctic waters it stays largely ice-free thanks to the Gulf Stream.

name: Barents Sea
fact: A shelf sea of the Arctic Ocean north of Norway and Russia.

name: Andaman Sea
fact: Lies between the Andaman Islands and the Malay Peninsula.

name: Sea of Okhotsk
fact: Bounded by the Kamchatka Peninsula, the Kuril Islands and Sakhalin.

name: Weddell Sea
fact: Part of the Southern Ocean, known for its enormous floating ice shelves.

name: Ross Sea
fact: A deep bay of the Southern Ocean holding the world's largest ice shelf.
